notes.title: Happy birthday, Paperball!
notes.content:
It's been three years since Paperball first released, all the way back in 2020. Boy, that feels like an eternity ago, huh? Since then, we've released some amazing patches, DLC and even a Nintendo Switch port. We never expected it'd ever get this big, but we're very lucky thanks to all the support. We couldn't be more thankful for all the fans, art, streams, speedruns and more - you help us to make more games!

As a little birthday gift, Paperball is getting its price reduced - it now costs less than ten USD on all platforms, DLC included! If you don't own the DLC or Nintendo Switch version already, now is the perfect time. If you do, it'll make a great gift!

notes.title: Version 2.0.0 + DLC are on their way!
notes.content:
In case you missed it, huge updates are coming soon!

[previewyoutube=t-7Sp5nxYz0;full][/previewyoutube]

We are currently adding the finishing touches to the huge updates we've been working on, which will release on [b]September 18th[/b]!

The Version 2.0.0 update will add three new game modes to Paperball:
[list][*] [b]Mad Shuffle:[/b] Select which stage sets you want to play, shuffle all the stages and play them in a random order! You have limited lives in this mode. See how far you can make it! The more difficult stages you clear, the more points you will earn.
[*] [b]Blitz Mode:[/b] A mode that lets you jump! If you thought the game was too difficult, try jumping to clear chasms and discover new shortcuts! If you're a speedrunner, explore a whole new world as you jump off slopes to build up speed!
[*] [b]Flip Mode:[/b] Grab a friend and take control of a single ball together! The control switches every couple seconds between you and your friend. Get ready to blame each other for steering the ball into the abyss in this cooperative multiplayer mode!
[/list]

Additionally, 8 new skins will be added to the game, all free of charge!

Version 2.0.0 will also add support for three paid DLC packs, each bringing
[list] [*] 15 new stages,
[*] a new environment,
[*] new music, and
[*] 4 new skins
[/list]
to the table!

The DLC will sell for $1.99 each, or $4.49 if bought together.

I hope you all look forward to all the new content headed towards Paperball.
Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 is here!
notes.content:
[h2]Changelog Version 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0[/h2]

[h3]New Features and Adjustments[/h3]
[list][*] Added a prompt asking for confirmation when giving up, so the option isn't selected by accident
[*] Added support for resolutions up to 4K (4096x2304)
[*] Added filters for leaderboards
[*] Increased the scroll speed in leaderboards
[*] Made controllers more sensitive to more accurately reflect keyboard controls
[*] Made Medal Mode remember the stage that was selected last
[*] Made the UI display the user's personal best next to the target time in Medal Mode
[*] Added camera controls for mouse (the mouse cursor is now locked to accomodate for this)
[*] Made Medal Mode show the number of platinum medals collected in a world once their times are visible
[*] Added a "Next Stage" option when clearing a stage in Medal Mode
[*] Added the ability to mute BGM in the Audio Settings
[*] Mapped all controllers to Player 1 outside of multiplayer. This should help with some controller issues[/list]

[h3]Stage Changes[/h3]
[list][*] Changed the Gold time of World 11-4 (Dodge) from 11.59997 seconds to 12.00149 seconds
[*] Added a new platform to Expert 22 (Gables)[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed a display bug in the leaderboards. Hours are now correctly displayed
[*] Fixed a bug where cancelling on the medal results in Medal Mode would not take the player back to the menu
[*] Fixed an issue where rotating the camera differed in speed depending on the framerate
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera would tilt when it was tilted before restarting[/list]
